article.content: Black Agenda Report October 30, 2026 Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 10/30/2026 - 01:19 Black Agenda Radio · Black Agenda Report October 30, 2026 In this week’s segment, we discuss Brazil's presidential election, where the incumbent president secured victory after losing in the first round of voting. But we begin with a conversation about an Elon Musk data center in Memphis, Tennessee, where the community is organizing for a moratorium on data centers in opposition to their elected officials, who answer to business interests instead of to their constituents.
